# Synthetic controlled-comparison evidence

The 2026-09-08 [report](report.json) retains all twelve measured checked context
samples, eight measured text samples, and three labelled warmups. Sources,
prompts and answers are synthetic. No private workspace contents or credentials
were captured. The public server profile uses filenames and the pinned model
digest. Machine identifiers, OS process IDs, exact process launch timestamps,
absolute machine paths and system-wide host snapshots remain in ignored local
evidence. Workload settings, synthetic results and source/executable hashes remain.
